title: Stopped Syncing Steps From Gear S2 Since iOS 15.4 Update
body:
As the title suggests, the app stopped syncing the steps from my gear S2 that is connected via Bluetooth and is registered in Galaxy Watch.

Galaxy Watch still shows battery percentage of the watch and shows it's connected but this app would keep saying it can't find any wearable devices.

Tried reinstalling both Galaxy Watch and Samsung Health. Tried restarting the watch. Tried restarting my phone. Didn't fix anything.
